Enlarged central 0.7 mm window. Each complete run is about 12.31 mm long; the right member uses the mirrored strategy.
BEFORE: center island printed before its supporting walls
AFTER: printed walls → band 1 → band 2 → band 3
Detached road: no contact with the previous-layer walls.
The original loop began here at 10 mm/s.

2 mm/s · 100% part fan · ≈0.164 mm lateral steps · nominal width 0.217056 mm
Normal supported contours are printed first and kept intact. Only the detached first island is replaced.
Bands show calculated bead footprints, not measured material. Working reference method adapted from 0.4 mm to 0.2 mm nozzle.
Static checks verify geometric attachment and overlap; physical bonding and print quality still require a test.
